summary: Zhengye Biotechnology Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) minimum bid price requirement. The company received a letter from Nasdaq on August 5, 2026, confirming that its Class A ordinary shares closed at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from July 20 to August 4, 2026. The company previously disclosed non-compliance on May 29, 2026. This is a routine listing compliance matter, not a special situation. The stock remains listed on Nasdaq Capital Market under ticker ZYBT. No restructuring, tender offer, or other event is involved.
